title: Spinnin' On It (Easy)
statementMd:
**The difference between the versions is the constraint on N.**

Although the [Red River Rivalry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_River_Rivalry) is in Dallas nowadays, Akshaj decided to use the game as motivation to explore the state his new university would (yet again) thrash. While taking a unique route he stumbles upon the [Great Prairie Wind Farm](https://www.gem.wiki/Great_Prairie_wind_farm). The wind farm contains N turbines in a row, where the ith turbine has rotation period ai seconds.

Akshaj wants to take a picture of these turbines, but he can only do so when they are all aligned in their "neutral" state. A picture is represented by a contiguous subsegment of the turbines, and if Akshaj has to wait longer than T seconds for alignment he will opt to not take this photograph. Note that at t=0 all of the turbines are aligned at their "neutral" state, but Akshaj must take the photograph at a positive time t>0.

Akshaj wants to make sure he has enough storage, and thus needs to know both how many pictures he can take and their total size. Can you help him out?

## Input

The first line contains two integers: N (1≤N≤5000) and T (1≤T≤106), the number of turbines and the max time he will wait. The second line contains N space-separated integers (1≤ai≤105), where ai is the rotation period of the ith turbine.

## Output

Your output should be two space-separate integers C and S. C should be the number of pictures he can take, and S should be the sum of the lengths of all pictures he can take.

## Note

In the sample test case, the possible pictures he can take (represented by the periods themselves and *not* the indices) are [2], [1], [1,3], and [3]. The pictures below should help (courtesy of querying Astra with a rough sketch), where the black blade must be pointed directly up to be neutral.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d8e3de4249215e1b894cae62e7275757bfe53ef6.png)

†Like most things I write, the title of this problem was [Kpop-inspired](https://open.spotify.com/track/4pH8rClaLsi6QcDGrw2VgV?si=d89bd46b994d4985).
statementZhMd:
**两个版本的区别在于 N 的约束条件。**

虽然如今的[红河对抗赛](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_River_Rivalry)在达拉斯举行，Akshaj 还是决定以这场比赛为契机，探索一下那个即将被他的新大学（再次）痛击的州。他走了一条别具一格的路线，途中偶然发现了[大草原风电场](https://www.gem.wiki/Great_Prairie_wind_farm)。这座风电场有 N 台排成一行的风力发电机，其中第 i 台风力发电机的旋转周期为 ai 秒。

Akshaj 想给这些风力发电机拍照，但只有当它们全部对齐到各自的“初始”位置时才能拍摄。一张照片对应这些风力发电机的一个连续子段；如果需要等待超过 T 秒才能使它们对齐，Akshaj 就会放弃拍摄这张照片。注意，在 t=0 时，所有风力发电机都对齐在各自的“初始”位置，但 Akshaj 必须在某个正的时刻 t>0 拍照。

Akshaj 想确保自己的存储空间足够，因此需要知道他能拍多少张照片，以及这些照片的总大小。你能帮帮他吗？

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数：N (1≤N≤5000) 和 T (1≤T≤106)，分别表示风力发电机的数量和他愿意等待的最长时间。第二行包含 N 个以空格分隔的整数 (1≤ai≤105)，其中 ai 为第 i 台风力发电机的旋转周期。

## 输出格式

输出两个以空格分隔的整数 C 和 S。C 表示他能拍摄的照片数量，S 表示所有能拍摄的照片所对应子段的长度之和。

## 说明

在样例测试中，他可以拍摄的照片（用旋转周期本身表示，*而非*下标）为 [2]、[1]、[1,3] 和 [3]。下图应该有助于理解（由 Astra 根据一张草图生成），其中黑色叶片必须竖直朝上才算处于初始位置。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d8e3de4249215e1b894cae62e7275757bfe53ef6.png)

†和我写的大多数东西一样，这道题的标题也[受到了 Kpop 的启发](https://open.spotify.com/track/4pH8rClaLsi6QcDGrw2VgV?si=d89bd46b994d4985)。
